text: No money, no map. Come back when you have it.
I told you already. I have one tip a round, and you have it.
Another wave. I think I will push the bike.
Post for the villages, and a bicycle that died at the gate. I have been mending it an hour, and the dead keep coming up the road.
I ride the whole district. I know every crate and every cache. For a little Scrip I will tell you what I saw.
For two hundred. The crate is there, the one the soldiers left. I saw the lid lifted with my own eyes.
A tip is a tip. Do not spend it all in one place.
Someone is down! I cannot leave the bike. I cannot!
